module: "Preview / playback" part of photo mode. It adds the full photo mode state (camera, scene, effects, advanced render, capture) and the presets to a capture's metadata, then lets you replay a capture from this metadata: loading the level if needed, placing the free camera, FOV and time of day. It can also open a preview's share URL in the browser.
notes: The playback functions return tables {ok=false, reason="..."} on failure (reasons: share_url_missing, browser_unavailable, open_web_failed, session_inactive, preview_metadata_invalid, preview_level_missing, extensions_load_unavailable, loadMapCmd_load_failed, loadMapCmd_unavailable, loadMapCmd_set_failed, camera_api_unavailable, camera_set_failed).

Playback in the same level is not immediate: the payload is stored in ui_photomode_shared.S.pendingPreviewPlayback and applied by handleUpdate once the photo session is closed and the game state is neither empty nor "menu". For another level, core_loadMapCmd.set(payload, false) is called right away (the module is set to manual unload).
Minor game bug: logTag is not declared locally in this file; the log("E", logTag, ...) calls therefore use a probably nil global (the message is logged without a valid tag).
The expected opening metadata field (openMap): level (required), camPos (3 numbers), camRot (4 numbers, quaternion), fov (> 0), timeOfDay.

openPreviewShareUrl.desc: Opens a preview's share URL in the web browser, if the media action "preview.openShareUrl" is enabled.

shareUrl.desc: URL to open; empty or nil gives reason="share_url_missing".

collectScreenshotMetadata.desc: Completes a capture's metadata table with metadata.photomodeState (schemaVersion, camera, scene, effects, advancedRender, capture) and metadata.photomodePresets (preset bundle). Does nothing if the photo session is not active or if metadata is not a table.

playPreviewFromMetadata.desc: Prepares the playback of a capture from its metadata. Requires an active photo session. If the level is different, triggers its loading immediately; otherwise puts the payload on hold for handleUpdate.

openMap.desc: Opening metadata {level, camPos, camRot, fov, timeOfDay}.

handleUpdate.desc: Called every frame by the photo mode loop (update hook); applies the pending preview playback (switch to free camera, setPosRot, setFOV, setTimeOfDay) when the conditions are met. The time arguments are not used.
